```text
I added the missing Delete button and the server endpoint it calls, but I couldn't run anything: both the syntax check and `node --test` were blocked at the permission prompt. I checked the code by reading it, so Relayvora's rerun will be the first real test.

**What was wrong:** the app could save and list items but had no way to delete them. Each list item was plain text, and the server had no delete route, so Kane found no Delete button.

**What I changed (only `server.mjs`):**
- **Page:** every list item now shows its name followed by a visible "Delete" button. Clicking it sends a delete request to the server and redraws the list in place, without reloading the page.
- **Server:** added a delete route (`DELETE /api/items`) that takes `{ index, name }`. It removes the item at that position if the name matches, otherwise the first item with that name. It returns 204 on success, 404 if there's no such item and 400 for a malformed request.
- **Persistence:** the delete removes the item from the server's in-memory list, so it stays gone after a page refresh. That's the same storage saving already uses.
- **Saving:** the save path and `GET /api/items` are unchanged and still return a plain list of names, which is what the regression test expects.

I didn't touch `spec.md` or `regression.test.mjs`, didn't start or restart the app, and didn't commit.

```
